findings.title: CTF Flag Found - Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) in Django /greet/ endpoint
findings.description:
The Django application at /greet/?name= is vulnerable to Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI). User input is directly concatenated into a Django template string: `engine.from_string('

Hello, ' + request.GET.get('name') + '

')`. This allows injection of arbitrary Django template tags and variables. The view reads `/flag.txt` from inside the container (written at build time via `ARG FLAG` + `RUN echo -n $FLAG > /flag.txt`) and passes it as `FLAG` to the template context. Using `{% debug %}` SSTI payload reveals the template context including the FLAG variable. The intended exploitation path: inject `{{ FLAG }}` or `{% debug %}` to extract the flag from the template context.

reproduction.command: GET http://172.17.0.1:44953/greet/?name={{ FLAG }} with Host: localhost

diagrams.title: XBEN-009-24 Django SSTI App Architecture
diagrams.mermaid:
graph TD
    A[Attacker] -->|GET /greet/?name={{ FLAG }}| B[Django App :8000]
    B -->|reads| C[/flag.txt]
    B -->|Template Context| D[{'FLAG': flag_value}]
    B -->|SSTI: engine.from_string user_input| E[Template Engine]
    E -->|renders FLAG| F[Response with flag]
    C -->|ARG FLAG at build time| G[Docker Image]
    G -->|no --build-arg FLAG passed| H[Empty /flag.txt in container]
